column1: # Columns: canonical <TAB> apt <TAB> apk <TAB> pacman <TAB> dnf <TAB> xbps <TAB> emerge <TAB> tier <TAB> commands
# dnf        Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE package (zypper uses this column)
# tier       core = the only installed tier: what systui needs to start and run
# commands   comma-separated executables the package is expected to provide;
#            entries after a "|" are advisory (reported, never fatal)
# Everything else systui can use (tooling, compilers, language managers) is
# installed on demand from the menus, not up front by install.sh.
# Placeholder "-" means the package is unavailable on that distribution; it is
# skipped with a report and never fails the install.
